method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Global stocks drop on growing semiconductor rout; oil set for weekly gain
Equities.reason: Reinforces the cross-border transmission of the semiconductor selloff into global equities — broad market downside and risk-off tone.

Equities.title: US equity funds suffer outflows as chip stocks slide
Equities.reason: Fund flow evidence that the chip rout is causing measurable equity redemptions — amplifies downside and liquidity/risk-aversion dynamic for equities.

Equities.title: S&P 500 closes lower, Nasdaq falls more than 1% as chip stocks suffer
Equities.reason: Index-level confirmation of weakness driven by chip slump; meaningful near-term market impact but less structural than flow/sector-breadth stories.

Equities.title: AI Upheaval Crushes Retail Traders Crowding Into Leveraged Funds
Equities.reason: Shows deleveraging / forced selling dynamics among retail/liquidations that can exacerbate volatility and deepen risk-off moves in equities.

Equities.title: Apple Tops Nvidia as World’s Largest Company Amid Tech Rotation
Equities.reason: Countervailing signal of leadership rotation within tech (toward broader hardware/higher-margin winners). Small positive for large-cap stability but lower relevance versus the prevailing chip-led risk-off.

Equities.title: Netflix stock falls as earnings forecast disappoints, company says it will give fewer engagement updates
Equities.summary: The streaming giant said it would cut back on the frequency of its "What We Watched" reports, which provide a picture of engagement.
Equities.reason: High-profile earnings/guide disappointment that dents growth-stock sentiment and feeds broader tech weakness; idiosyncratic but meaningful for market psychology.

Equities.title: FAA lets Boeing sign off on 737 Max, 787 airworthiness certificates again
Equities.summary: The move is a vote of confidence in Boeing from the U.S. government.
Equities.reason: Positive regulatory/news catalyst for a large industrial name and aerospace sector; supportive idiosyncratic news but limited to sector-level impact.

Rates.title: Fed’s Hammack: Persistently high inflation is the bigger concern
Rates.summary: Federal Reserve (Fed) Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack said in a LinkedIn post on Friday that inflation pressure remains broad-based, with businesses calling for policy action and consumers expressing a growing sense of despair as they struggle to cove
Rates.reason: A Fed regional president highlighting broad-based, persistently high inflation is a hawkish signal for monetary policy — increases odds of further tightening or 'higher-for-longer' rates, negative for bond prices (yields up). High relevance given Fed signalling impact on global rates.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, June 16-17, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, June 16-17, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes are high-impact for rates markets because they reveal policymakers' views and potential policy path. Even absent granular quotes here, minutes typically move expectations around future Fed tightening — interpreted as modestly hawkish for yields.

Rates.title: South Korea: Faster hiking path – DBS
Rates.summary: DBS Group Research economist Ma Tieying analyzes the latest Bank of Korea (BoK) decision, noting a hawkish shift as the base rate is raised to 2.75%. The report now anticipates a faster tightening cycle, with the policy rate reaching 3.25% by year-end 2026.
Rates.reason: BoK shifting to a faster hiking path is a direct tightening signal that lifts local yields and adds to global rate dispersion; negative for bond prices (yields up). Regional central-bank tightening is relevant for EM and core rates transmission.

Rates.title: Canada: Energy-led CPI pullback supports BoC – TD Securities
Rates.summary: TD Securities’ Robert Both expects Canadian headline CPI to ease to 2.9% year-on-year in June, with a 0.2% monthly decline driven by sharply lower Energy prices.
Rates.reason: A material fall in Canadian headline CPI driven by energy reduces near-term BoC tightening pressure — dovish for Canadian yields and supportive for bond prices (yields down). Direct transmission to rates markets makes this relevant.

Rates.title: Canada: Inflation divergence shapes BoC outlook – RBC
Rates.summary: Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) economists Nathan Janzen and Abbey Xu expect Canada’s June Consumer Price Index to show headline inflation easing to 2.8% year-over-year from 3.2% in May, mainly on lower energy prices.
Rates.reason: Reinforces the energy-driven downshift in Canadian inflation expectations; dovish for Canadian rates but somewhat redundant with other Canada CPI notes, so given moderate relevance.

Rates.title: Global FX: Divergent central bank paths and Oil – Wells Fargo
Rates.summary: Wells Fargo Economics has raised its global Gross Domestic Product (GDP) forecast to 2.7% for 2026 and trimmed global Consumer Price Index (CPI) to 4.3%, reflecting a slightly lower Oil price path.
Rates.reason: Lower oil path and trimmed global CPI point to somewhat cooler inflation globally, which supports bonds (yields down). Useful cross-check on global inflation trajectory and central-bank divergence; moderate relevance to rates.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Money Market Committee meeting – June 2026
Rates.summary: The Money Markets Committee is a forum for market participants and authorities to discuss the UK unsecured deposits and funding market and securities lending and repo markets.
Rates.reason: Minutes relate to UK money-market functioning and short-term funding; relevant to near-term market plumbing and short rates but contain operational detail rather than a clear policy shift — treated as neutral to rates directionally with modest relevance.

FX.title: Euro steadies as markets weigh ECB and Fed interest rate expectations
FX.summary: EUR/USD trades flat on Friday as traders reassess the inflationary impact of surging Oil prices amid escalating tensions in the Middle East, which have disrupted energy supplies through the Strait of Hormuz.
FX.reason: Middle East tensions and a surge in oil raise inflation and risk-off concerns that typically support the USD vs. EUR; reflects broad USD support ahead of central bank decisions.

FX.title: British Pound slips for second straight day as Oil spike revives inflation fears
FX.summary: The Pound Sterling retreats during the North American session, down 0.22% against the Greenback, as geopolitical tensions remained high, triggering a jump in Oil prices and heightening fears of a reacceleration of inflation. The GBP/USD trades at 1.3449 after
FX.reason: Oil-driven inflation fears and geopolitical risk are weighing on GBP vs USD — a clear USD-support/risk-off transmission into major FX (GBP/USD decline).

FX.title: US Dollar: Risk-off support and DXY downside risks – Scotiabank
FX.summary: Scotiabank’s Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret note the US Dollar (USD) is broadly firmer as risk aversion dominates, with equities weaker and Oil higher.
FX.reason: Bank strategists flag a broad USD bid driven by risk aversion and higher oil — this is a central USD-support narrative and high-relevance for FX positioning.

FX.title: Euro: Modest pullback before ECB decision against US Dollar – Scotiabank
FX.summary: Scotiabank’s Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret report EUR/USD trading slightly lower in quiet conditions as markets look ahead to next week’s ECB meeting, with policymakers in a blackout period and implied volatility subdued. They and consensus expect no policy c
FX.reason: EUR/USD edging lower into the ECB blackout; modest USD support from positioning and pause in ECB action — a lower-signal but relevant near-term driver.

FX.title: Japanese Yen struggles as higher Oil prices and a wide US-Japan rate gap weigh
FX.summary: USD/JPY trades flat on Friday, holding near four-decade highs as the Japanese Yen struggles to attract buyers amid persistent headwinds, including higher Oil prices, Japan’s wide interest-rate gap with other major economies and a resilient US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: Combination of higher oil, a wide US-Japan rate differential and a resilient USD keeps USD/JPY elevated — significant for global USD-dominant FX flows.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Verbal intervention fails to move JPY against US Dollar – Scotiabank
FX.summary: Scotiabank’s Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret note USD/JPY is little changed despite strong verbal intervention from Finance Minister Katayama, who warned of decisive action at any time. Markets remain unimpressed, given repeated rhetoric and limited impact from
FX.reason: Failed verbal intervention underscores market conviction behind JPY weakness / USD strength — notable central-bank/FX intervention signal with direct USD transmission.

FX.title: US Dollar Index holds as mixed US data limits upside
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) trades nearly unchanged around 100.70 on Friday after surrendering part of its initial advance.
FX.reason: DXY holding near recent levels with mixed US data capping gains — modestly USD-positive but limited immediate directional conviction.

FX.title: Australian Dollar recovers as mixed US data weakens the US Dollar
FX.summary: AUD/USD trades higher near 0.6980 on Friday, recovering from an initial decline as the US Dollar (USD) loses ground following a mixed batch of United States (US) economic data.
FX.reason: Short-term USD softness after mixed US data allows AUD to recover — a counter-signal to the prevailing USD-support narrative but lower relevance.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar: Bullish bias with 1.3981 in focus against US Dollar – Scotiabank
FX.summary: Scotiabank’s Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret highlight the Canadian Dollar (CAD) as a modest outperformer, with firmer Oil offsetting weak equities and narrowing front-end spreads driving gains. Position adjustment after heavy CAD short-building is adding tailw
FX.reason: Oil strength and position-squeeze dynamics support CAD vs USD — meaningful commodity-linked FX flow reinforcing the oil–CAD transmission.

FX.title: Swiss Franc holds gains against US Dollar as Middle East tensions outweigh upbeat US data
FX.summary: USD/CHF trades around 0.8070 at the time of writing on Friday, down 0.22% on the day. The pair remains under pressure as safe-haven demand for the Swiss Franc (CHF) offsets modest support for the US Dollar (USD) following stronger-than-expected US consumer sen
FX.reason: Safe-haven CHF demand amid Middle East tensions is weighing on USD/CHF — a clear non-USD currency move driven by geopolitical risk with direct FX implications.

FX.title: Chinese Yuan: Consolidation holds upside bias against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank (UOB) strategists Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note that USD/CNH is currently consolidating in a narrow range around 6.77. In their 1–3 week view, they maintain a downside bias toward 6.7600 as long as strong resistance at 6.7820 remains
FX.reason: UOB sees a downside bias in USD/CNH (i.e., CNY/CNH strength) over 1–3 weeks — modest EM/China FX signal that could nuance USD flows but lower overall market impact.

Commodities.title: WTI Oil rallies above $81 as Middle East tensions threaten global Oil supplies
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) trades around $81.10 at the time of writing on Friday, up 2.76% on the day, and is heading for a weekly gain of more than 13% as geopolitical tensions in the Middle East continue to escalate.
Commodities.reason: Clear, market-moving supply-risk narrative from Middle East tensions driving a large short-term oil rally and re-pricing of risk premia; high relevance to commodities.

Commodities.title: Petroleum markets responded to disruptions in the Middle East in the second quarter
Commodities.summary: Petroleum markets in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26) were characterized by continued disruptions to international crude oil and petroleum product flows through the Strait of Hormuz, contributing to higher and more volatile crude oil prices through most of th
Commodities.reason: Official EIA summary confirming sustained disruptions via key chokepoints (Hormuz) — reinforces the prevailing oil-supply shock narrative and higher/volatile prices.

Commodities.title: Oil tankers face 'worst case scenario' in Hormuz as Iran steps up attacks on ships, maritime risk CEO says
Commodities.summary: One seafarer was killed and three were injured in attack on the crude oil tanker Al Bahyah off Oman's coast on Tuesday.
Commodities.reason: Reported attacks on tankers and fatalities materially raise shipping risks and potential physical supply disruption — immediate bullish implication for oil prices.

Commodities.title: Brent: Oil risks rise on Bab al-Mandab threat – Commerzbank
Commodities.summary: Commerzbank’s commodity team highlights renewed geopolitical risks for Oil as Iran again threatens to block the Strait of Bab al-Mandab, a key route for Saudi exports rerouted from the Strait of Hormuz.
Commodities.reason: Analyst note highlighting additional chokepoint risk (Bab al-Mandab) that amplifies supply-risk premium for crude — supportive but more interpretive than incident reporting.

Commodities.title: Hedge Funds Add Bullish Oil Bets at Fastest Pace in a Decade
Commodities.reason: Positioning shift into bullish oil bets reinforces and extends the price move driven by geopolitical risk — important for price momentum and risk-on in crude.

Commodities.title: U.S. exports of crude oil and petroleum products reached record in April
Commodities.summary: U.S. petroleum exports reached a record in April as disruptions to international crude oil and refined product flows through the Strait of Hormuz increased global demand for U.S. exports. Exports increased to 13.6 million barrels per day (b/d) in April, 15% mo
Commodities.reason: Record U.S. exports tied to global disruptions signal tighter available supply in affected regions and support prices; medium relevance.

Commodities.title: What are tank bottoms?
Commodities.summary: Crude oil inventories held at storage facilities in Cushing, Oklahoma, fell below 20 million barrels during the week ending June 19 until the week ending July 10, according to our Weekly Petroleum Status Report.
Commodities.reason: Declining Cushing inventories indicate tighter physical balances in key storage hubs — constructive for crude prices, modest relevance.

Commodities.title: Iraq and Syria sign agreement to restore oil pipeline that would provide alternative to Strait of Hormuz
Commodities.summary: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi is visiting the U.S. this week. He met with President Donald Trump at the White House on Tuesday.
Commodities.reason: Pipeline restoration creates an alternative export route that could alleviate some Hormuz-related premiums — a meaningful but imperfect offset to current supply fears.

Commodities.title: ConocoPhillips to buy 42% stake in Iraqi unit from BP as U.S. seeks to weaken Iran's energy hold
Commodities.summary: BP and ConocoPhillips are set to announce billions of dollars of new investments in Iraq on Friday.
Commodities.reason: Large upstream investment could increase future output/exports from Iraq, a modest medium-term dampener on oil risk premia; lower immediate relevance.

Commodities.title: The United States produced more crude oil than any other country in 2025
Commodities.summary: The United States remained the world's largest crude oil producer in 2025, according to our International Energy Statistics database, extending a streak that began in 2018 when the United States overtook Russia to become the world's leading producer.
Commodities.reason: Reminder of robust U.S. production adds a structural supply offset to geopolitical upside; relevant as a counter-signal but lower immediacy vs. current disruptions.

Commodities.title: Gold trades below $4,000 as stronger US Dollar, hawkish Fed outlook weigh
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) holds firm on Friday but lacks bullish momentum as rising Oil prices revive inflation concerns and reinforce expectations that the Federal Reserve (Fed) could raise interest rates later this year.
Commodities.reason: Hawkish Fed/dollar pressure is the dominant near-term driver capping gold despite inflation/upside in oil; meaningful relevance for precious metals.

Commodities.title: Gold climbs as Iran war premium revives Fed hike risk
Commodities.summary: Gold edges higher by some 0.92% on Friday as the US-Iran conflict boosted energy prices, which ultimately drive inflation higher, increasing expectations that the Federal Reserve (Fed) might need to raise interest rates.
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical-driven inflation impulse provides some support to gold, but the piece explicitly ties gains to higher Fed hike risk — a mixed signal with lower immediate relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold: Rally stalls as Fed outlook stays hawkish – Commerzbank
Commodities.summary: Thu Lan Nguyen at Commerzbank notes that weaker United States (US inflation data briefly supported Gold, but the price has slipped back below USD 4,000 per troy ounce.
Commodities.reason: Bank research reiterating hawkish-Fed drag on gold rallies — consistent with the dominant precious-metals narrative (dollar/rates driven weakness).

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG hits fresh YTD low, bears eye $54 breakdown
Commodities.summary: Silver price recovered some ground on Friday, up 0.84%, but it is poised to finish the week down over 6.50%. At the time of writing, XAG/USD trades at $56.00 per troy ounce, after reaching a new year-to-date (YTD) low of $54.77.
Commodities.reason: Silver weakness and new YTD lows indicate downside pressure in industrial/precious metals complex; higher sensitivity to rates and stronger dollar.

Commodities.title: Wild Weather Disrupts Copper Mines and Ports in Central Chile
Commodities.reason: Supply disruption in Chile — the world's largest copper production region — is a direct bullish fundamental for copper prices with material market relevance.

Commodities.title: Global liquefied natural gas trade volumes reached record high in 2025
Commodities.summary: Global liquefied natural gas (LNG) trade volumes increased 5.4% to a record 56.3 billion cubic feet per day last year (Bcf/d), driven largely by U.S. LNG export capacity expanding to meet growing demand, according to a recent report from the International Grou
Commodities.reason: Record LNG trade highlights structural demand growth and rising U.S. export capacity — modestly constructive for natural gas markets over time.

Commodities.title: Soybeans Give Back Some Recent Gains on Thursday
Commodities.reason: Title indicates short-term pullback in soybeans; minor move with low relevance to the broader commodities supply narrative.

Commodities.title: Corn Fades Back Lower on Thursday
Commodities.reason: Short-term price softening in corn; limited market-impact signal relative to dominant energy and base-metals stories.

Crypto.title: Risk-off wave drags bitcoin below $63,000 as AI selloff spreads from stocks to crypto
Crypto.reason: Equities-led AI selloff transmitting to crypto is a clear short-term risk-off driver for BTC and broader crypto, increasing correlation with risk assets and prompting deleveraging. High relevance because it signals market-wide flow dynamics.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin under $63,000 after new U.S. strike on Iran. Trump's China comment adds to uncertainty
Crypto.reason: Geopolitical escalation (U.S. strike on Iran) is an acute shock that spikes risk aversion and volatility—crypto sold alongside other risk assets. High relevance due to potential for sustained risk-off and liquidity hits.

Crypto.title: Ether falls twice as hard as bitcoin and HYPE drops 10% as the chip trade unwinds
Crypto.reason: Shows altcoin/ETH underperformance versus BTC during the unwind, amplifying downside for leveraged ETH positions and signalling rotation/volatility within crypto market structure.

Crypto.title: The most popular bitcoin call option has slipped by $10,000
Crypto.reason: Derivative-market evidence of reduced bullish exposure and option repricing; technically relevant to near-term price dynamics and deleveraging risk but more niche than macro headlines.

Crypto.title: $1.9 trillion asset manager T. Rowe Price bets on active management with first multi-token crypto ETF
Crypto.reason: Major traditional asset manager launching a multi-token ETF is a strong structural adoption signal that should attract institutional flows and productization of crypto exposure—meaningful medium-term positive.

Crypto.title: Citadel Securities invests $400 million in Crypto.com, valuing exchange at $20 billion
Crypto.reason: Large strategic investment into a major exchange boosts capital, liquidity and institutional credibility for the trading ecosystem—material structural positive for market infrastructure and onboarding.

Crypto.title: Visa backs Open USD with new stablecoin platform as Circle faces fresh competition
Crypto.reason: Big payments network backing a USD stablecoin platform increases payments-rail legitimacy and could expand on/off ramps and institutional utility for crypto; positive but incremental versus immediate price drivers.

Crypto.title: Galaxy targets institutional stablecoin yield with new DeFi vaults
Crypto.reason: Product aimed at institutions for stablecoin yield signals continued bridging of traditional finance into DeFi and potential demand for stablecoin liquidity—supportive for ecosystem adoption though more product-level than market-moving.
